title: 第21章 守关人第22章 不该被忘记的战斗
content_zh:
;;
苏白尘这天是背着一大篓小海鲜回去的，准备去清洗一下，给自家师父准备一顿丰盛的海鲜大餐。
那位在浅滩上遇到的女前辈叫做水阴姬，对于这么个敢跑到她地界上捡海鲜的小孩也没怎么为难，只是问了问他师父是谁就随便他了。
“你这是从哪里弄来的？”
玄阴真人惊讶地询问。
苏白尘老实回答：“是水阴师叔那里捡的，师叔说以后可以常去。”
玄阴真人面皮抽动了一下：“水阴师妹啊……罢了，她让你常去你就常去看看好了。”
说话时他的表情好像有些不对劲，带着些恍惚的感觉……不对劲啊，这里面是不是有故事？
苏白尘眨了眨眼，眼神带上了一些八卦的色彩。
他好奇地问：“水阴前辈和师父关系很好吗？”
玄阴真人没好气地给了他一个栗子：“去做你的饭，大人的事情小孩别多嘴！”
苏白尘的脑门被敲得脆响，只能捂着脑袋干活去了。
这一夜，他做了蒜蓉生蚝，做了盐焗大虾，还做了铁锹海鲜……反正，吃就是了。
苏白尘现在只是庆幸料理这些海鲜不用多少麻烦，只要清洗干净了随便怎么弄熟了就都会很好吃。
而他接下来的日子也仿佛是这天的复刻，时不时地去那浅滩捡海鲜，顺便也会给那水阴姬送一些师父做的菜。
玄阴真人意外地有一手好厨艺……或许这和他选择以美食的爱好来锚定自身人性有关系。
而当苏白尘偷偷地把玄阴真人做的菜给水阴姬送过去以后，哪怕他从未说明这是哪里来的，哪怕甚至是隔夜的，水阴姬也是肉眼可见地高兴。
他在这浅滩更是混得开了，水阴姬甚至会下水去帮他抓几个巴掌大的鲍鱼来给他尝鲜。
偶尔苏白尘也会去钓鱼，当然，那老头的钓点他是不敢去了，免得再发生理念冲突。
但没想到每次他一甩下鱼竿，那老头就会像装了雷达一样地跑过来，然后不停地嘴臭……

苏白尘就觉得很无奈，但也没有放弃钓鱼，毕竟他发现这老头其实乐在其中……罢了，就当关爱空巢老人了。
而他闲逛的时候又跑到了廊桥最末端，最接近阴风峡深处的那个位置。
这里其实没人居住，只是有一处岗哨时时观察着阴风峡内部的情况。
苏白尘来这里纯粹是因为好奇，过来‘开地图’的。
却没想到这岗哨上有个不苟言笑的‘哨兵’，他居然是一副武将装束，头发胡须雪白，双眼一眨不眨地盯着那阴风峡，对于苏白尘的到来毫无所觉。
苏白尘远远抱拳行了一礼也就没有打扰。
他只是好奇这阴风峡内是否有什么好吃的海鲜。
于是他就在那哨塔下头准备垂钓。
然而就在这个时候，一旦钓鱼就必然出现的那个钓鱼老头瞬移一般地踩点出现。
他没好气地说：“你怎么跑到冰块脸这里来钓鱼了？”
“这里可没什么好鱼，阴气太重了，没有活物受得了的。”
苏白尘伸手一拉鱼竿，猛然间将一条黑黝黝的长条状玩意儿给提了起来。
这是一条大鳗鱼！
钓鱼老头没好气地说：“你又用幻术钓鱼了！”

Su Baichen went back that day carrying a large basket of small seafood, intending to clean it and prepare a sumptuous seafood dinner for his master.
The female senior I met on the shoal was called Shuiyin Ji. She didn't have much trouble with such a child who dared to run to her territory to pick up seafood. She just asked him who his master was and let him go.
"Where did you get this?"
Master Xuanyin asked in surprise.
Su Baichen answered honestly: "I picked it up from Uncle Shuiyin. Uncle Shuiyin said he could go there more often in the future."
Master Xuanyin's face twitched: "Junior Sister Shuiyin...that's all. If she asks you to go there often, just go and see her."
There seemed to be something wrong with his expression when he spoke, with a trance-like feeling... Something wasn't right. Is there a story in it?
Su Baichen blinked, his eyes filled with gossip.
He asked curiously: "Does Senior Shuiyin have a good relationship with Master?"
Master Xuanyin gave him a chestnut angrily: "Go and make your meal. Children, don't talk too much about adults' matters!"
Su Baichen's forehead was knocked loudly, and he could only cover his head and work.
That night, he made garlic oysters, salt-baked prawns, and shovel seafood... Anyway, that's all.
Su Baichen was just glad that cooking these seafood didn't require much trouble. As long as they were cleaned and cooked in any way, they would be delicious.
And the following days seemed to be a repeat of that day. From time to time, he would go to the shoal to pick up seafood, and by the way, he would also give Shuiyin Ji some dishes cooked by his master.
Master Xuanyin unexpectedly has good cooking skills...perhaps this has something to do with his choice to anchor his humanity with his love of food.
And when Su Baichen secretly sent the dishes cooked by Master Xuanyin to Shui Yin Ji, even though he never explained where it came from, even if it was overnight, Shui Yin Ji was visibly happy.
He was even more able to get along in the shallows. Shui Yinji would even go into the water to help him catch a few palm-sized abalones for him to try.
Occasionally, Su Baichen would go fishing. Of course, he would not dare to go to the old man's fishing spot to avoid another conflict of ideas.
But I didn't expect that every time he flicked the fishing rod, the old man would come running over like he was equipped with a radar, and he would keep having a bad mouth...
Su Baichen felt helpless, but he did not give up fishing. After all, he found that the old man actually enjoyed it... That's all, he just regarded it as caring for the empty nesters.
While he was wandering around, he ran to the end of the covered bridge, the position closest to the depths of Yinfeng Gorge.
In fact, no one lives here, but there is a sentry station that constantly observes the situation inside Yinfeng Gorge.
Su Baichen came here purely out of curiosity and came to 'open the map'.
But he didn't expect that there was an unsmiling 'sentinel' on the sentry post. He was actually dressed as a military commander, with snow-white hair and beard. His eyes were staring at the Yinfeng Gorge without blinking, and he was completely unaware of Su Baichen's arrival.
Su Baichen clasped his fists and bowed from a distance without disturbing him.
He was just curious if there was any delicious seafood in Yinfeng Gorge.
So he prepared to fish under the sentry tower.
However, at this moment, the old fishing man who was bound to appear once fishing appeared teleportingly at the spot.
He said angrily: "Why did you come here to fish with Ice Cube Face?"
"There are no good fish here. The yin energy is too strong and no living creature can bear it."
Su Baichen stretched out his hand to pull the fishing rod, and suddenly lifted up a long black thing.
This is a big eel!
The old fishing man said angrily: "You used illusion magic to fish again!"
